title: Turn-Taking Tower
shareTitle: Turn-Taking Tower — Build, wait, cheer together
description: Build a bright wooden tower with a friendly buddy or a second player, taking turns one block at a time.
interactionModel: forgiving drag-or-tap block placement with an explicit wait-and-handoff rhythm
feedbackModel: the active friend glows, the matching block lifts toward its target, early taps get a gentle spoken waiting cue, and both builders celebrate the completed roof

modes.title: Buddy Build
modes.skill: wait and take turns with a friendly builder
